ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, there is a circle with A as the center, and points B, C, D, E are on the circle. Segment C-A-E is drawn as a straight line, indicating that CE is a diameter; segment B-A-D is also drawn as a straight line, indicating that BD is a diameter. The central angle ∠EAD is marked as 42° in the figure. Because AE and AC are opposite rays, and AD and AB are opposite rays, ∠EAD and ∠CAB are vertical angles, and the two are equal. Therefore m∠CAB = 42°. ∠CAB is the central angle intercepting arc BC, so m arc BC = m∠CAB = 42°.

method.method_draft: From the image, note that CE and BD are diameters through center A. The given central angle ∠EAD = 42° intercepts minor arc ED, so m arc ED = 42°. Since BD is a diameter, the semicircle from B to D through E has measure 180°, giving m arc BE = 180° − 42° = 138°. Since CE is a diameter, the semicircle from C to E through B has measure 180°, so m arc BC = 180° − m arc BE = 180° − 138° = 42°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是⊙A，A位于圆心；C、E在圆上且C-A-E成一直线，所以CE是直径；B、D在圆上且B-A-D成一直线，所以BD是直径；圆心角∠EAD标为42°。
推理：∠EAD是中央角，截得小弧ED，因此m弧ED=42°。因为BD是直径，从B到D经过E的半圆弧为180°，所以m弧BE=180°−42°=138°。又因为CE是直径，从C到E经过B的半圆弧为180°，所以m弧BC=180°−m弧BE=180°−138°=42°。
